metadata.title: Add support for multiple gateways in benchmark server and automate their testing in Locust
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

---

## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)
Adds multi-server mode to benchmark-server for pagination testing and integrates benchmark, fast-time, and fast-test servers into docker-compose.yml with monitoring profile. Implements intelligent gateway pre-registration in locustfile with auto-detection of available benchmark servers.

---

## 🎯 Key Changes
### Benchmark Server Multi-Server Mode
- New flags: `-server-count` and `-start-port` for spawning multiple MCP servers on sequential ports
- Graceful shutdown: Signal handling (SIGINT/SIGTERM) with connection draining
- Resource naming: Server ID in resource URIs for uniqueness in multi-server mode
- Supports SSE and HTTP transports (stdio excluded)
### Docker Compose Integration
- Updated monitoring profile: Runs benchmark (100 servers on 9000-9099), fast-time (8002), and fast-test (8880) servers
- Port conflict resolution: Moved fast-test from 9080 → 8880 to avoid benchmark server range
- Auto-registration service: Registers fast-test server on startup
- nginx load balancer: Port changed from 8000 → 8080
### Locust Load Testing Enhancements
- Auto-detection: `_detect_benchmark_servers()` queries Docker container ports or falls back to compose file
- Pre-registration: 15% of benchmark servers + fast-time/fast-test registered at test start
- Deduplication: `PREREGISTERED_BENCHMARK_PORTS` tracking prevents duplicate registration
- New task: `register_benchmark_gateway()` dynamically registers remaining servers during test
- Environment variables: `LOADTEST_BENCHMARK_START_PORT`, `LOADTEST_BENCHMARK_SERVER_COUNT`, `LOADTEST_BENCHMARK_HOST`
### Performance Testing Configuration
- Infrastructure profiles: Added `benchmark_server_*` config for development (10 servers), staging (100), production (1000), production_ha (10000)
- generate_docker_compose.py: Templates for fast-time, fast-test, benchmark servers with configurable tools/resources/prompts
### Database Fix
- gateway_service.py: Changed db.commit() → db.flush() in register_gateway() for proper transaction handling
- Test updates: All test mocks updated to expect flush() instead of commit()

---

## 🧪 Checks

- [x] `make lint` passes
- [x] `make test` passes

---

commits.message:
refactor: simplify benchmark server setup with dedicated profile

- Add dedicated "benchmark" profile with auto-registration at startup
- Add make benchmark-up/down/status/logs targets
- Reduce to 10 servers (ports 9000-9009) with auto-registration
- Remove complex auto-detection and dynamic registration from locustfile
- Benchmark servers registered via register_benchmark service at compose startup
- Remove benchmark from monitoring profile for cleaner separation

Usage: make benchmark-up

commits.message:
refactor: locust no longer registers gateways, add benchmark-clean and env vars

- Remove all gateway registration from locustfile.py (handled by compose services)
- Add benchmark-clean target to remove volumes
- Add BENCHMARK_SERVER_COUNT and BENCHMARK_START_PORT environment variables
- Support up to 100 benchmark servers (9000-9099 port range)
- Increased resource limits for larger deployments

Usage:
  make benchmark-up                           # Default: 10 servers
  BENCHMARK_SERVER_COUNT=50 make benchmark-up # Custom: 50 servers
  make benchmark-clean                        # Stop and remove volumes
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
